title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: intelligent summaries of Copilot adoption trends
summary: The briefing accurately reports the automatic November rollout, licence eligibility and whole-app control. The separate user/group access discussion should clarify that the documented route now manages the Viva Insights web app, rather than a dashboard-only control.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy for the web app.

Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.where: Governance controls: individual user/group access paragraph

claims.quote: Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. ... At the top, select Groups.
claims.fix: Keep the printed route, but replace 'Learn also describes a separate way to manage which individual users and groups can open the Copilot Dashboard' with 'Learn also describes a way to manage individual users and groups who can access the Viva Insights web app'. Replace the final sentence with 'This route manages access to the Viva Insights web app, not intelligent summaries alone; Learn says the previous dashboard-only controls are no longer available.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/admin/manage-settings-copilot-dashboard.
